title: Mommy Has Dreams Too
vol: Mommy Is Human Too · Book Thirteen
verse: Grown-ups have dreams too. Write your dream down, make it plain, and take one step at a time.

pages.text:
When all the house was sleeping and the dishes all were done,
Mommy opened up her books — a second day begun.

Jojo crept down for some water, and he saw the kitchen light:
there was Mommy at the table, writing late into the night.

"Mommy, what are you doing?" "Studying," she said.
"I'm going back to school, Jojo. Now you should be in bed!"

"School? But Mommy, you're a grown-up! Aren't you done with school?"
"Oh, no," she laughed. "A dream can grow at any age. That's the rule."

"When I was small, I dreamed of building, fixing, making things —
of learning how the warm air flows, and what the cold air brings.

But then I had you, Jojo, and then Pip, and then our Bee,
and I put all my dreams away so I could care for three.

I didn't stop my dreaming, though. I tucked it on a shelf.
And now I'm taking it back down, to grow a part of myself."

"But Mommy, you look tired," Jojo said, and rubbed his eyes.
"I am," she said. "Some nights are long. But dreams are worth the tries."

The next day Mommy yawned at breakfast, spilled a little juice,
and Pip said, "Mommy's sleepy!" — and the giggles all broke loose.

Then Jojo had an idea: "We can help you, Mommy, too!
We'll do our homework next to you, while you study like you do!"

So every night at seven, at the table, side by side,
the books come out for everyone — and Mommy's full of pride.

Pip "studies" with her crayons. Baby Bee chews on a page.
And Jojo reads his chapter book, the best one for his age.

And on the day that Mommy passed her test, they made a sign:
"OUR MOMMY DID IT!" — glitter, stars, and Pip's best squiggly line.

Because your Mommy has her dreams, and she is growing too —
and Mommy gets so tired sometimes… because she's human too.

items: What is one small step toward your dream?
How can our family help each other's dreams?
Write your dream on paper and put it where you can see it.
Make a sign to cheer someone on.
